china_race_dynamics.text: I have called it the next Manhattan Project for a reason. [...] the cost of being second was just devastating. [...] And I think AI has similar overlay. [...] If we are lagging, if we are behind China in AI, our sovereignty, our national defense is at risk. I think it is not an option for us to get second in AI.
china_race_dynamics.context: House Appropriations subcommittee hearing on Energy and Water Development, where Secretary Wright testifies on Department of Energy priorities for FY2026.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says being behind China in AI risks sovereignty and defense and that second place is not an option.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly frames AI competition with China as a national-security priority.
